scope: f57v and f67-f73 wheel pages; f85v2 Rosettes separately. Inventory from source unit descriptions, not glyph content. Not a new blinded image annotation. Missing/ambiguous units retained. on means circumferential band, even an inner band; inside means non-band text within envelope.
method: All observed contiguous EVA prefixes/suffixes/internal sequences and words. Strict v48 cleaning. H/F/U/V separate. Rosettes U/V only. Shared-locus U/V and H/U paired descriptive profiles. Same-page differences split by source format; do not call band-v-label contrasts spatial effects independent of format. No p-values or validation claim for sparse one-foldout comparisons. Circular transcription endpoints not interpreted as physical line edges.
features: All features output; focal qo,od,ke,eol plus top differences shown descriptively. No outcome-based changes to map.
